contracts: Review guidance stays a `#### Review guidance` block under a Story or Bug's Assumptions field: `- Check:`, `- Ignore:` and `- Risk:` lines; the issue forms do not change (#1221)

workitems.ParseGuidance(body) returns the checks, ignores and risks in order; Ready and slice refuse an Ignore that names security, data, concurrency, a floor, or a P0 or P1 area, and a line of another shape; a missing block warns (#1221)
delegate.BriefInput gains Guidance, read from the Ready snapshot's body, never the live issue, and rendered inside the untrusted quote; no guidance renders nothing (#1222)

inspect.Input gains Guidance from the same snapshot; it is in DiffHash only when present, so the cache of stories with none holds; an Ignore drops only a P2 or P3 finding outside the limits, and lists each drop in Dropped (#1223)
rollback: A revert of each story's squash undoes it: no ledger record or issue body is rewritten. Stories keep their guidance blocks as plain text. Reverting #1223 changes DiffHash only for stories with guidance, so their next review is judged again once.
